title: German Stroopwafel Tart
description: A delicious German-inspired dessert featuring a stroopwafel crust and a caramel-like filling.
instructions: Roll out the pre-made tart crust and place in a tart pan
Bake the crust for 12-15 minutes, or until lightly golden
In a medium saucepan, combine the chopped dates, stroop, heavy cream, granulated sugar, and cinnamon
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat, stirring frequently
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the filling has thickened slightly
Pour the filling into the baked tart crust
Bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, or until the filling is set
Allow the tart to cool completely before serving
